component.name: Atelier
component.summary: Sketch, make patterns, grade sizes and prepare tech packs

description.p: Atelier is for designing physical things: clothes, bags, shoes and products. One project holds the concept sketches, the parametric pattern with its sizes, the technical flats, the tech pack for production and the 3D fitting.

ul.li: Sketching with pressure and tilt sensitive brushes, rulers, ellipses, French curves, perspective grids and symmetry
Parametric pattern making driven by measurement tables, with seam allowances, notches, drill holes, grain lines and darts
Grading by rules or by measurements with a nested preview of every size
Technical flats with stitch lines, trims, dimensions and numbered callouts
Tech packs with points of measure, tolerances, bill of materials and construction steps
DXF AAMA and ASTM, Seamly2D, HPGL, SVG, PDF, glTF and OBJ
